# Brief workflow

Read `../../reference/review-rules.md` before drafting a brief, including when starting directly in this directory.

## Drafting

Keep reviewer commentary outside the final brief.

For factual claims, cite the supplied source and include its page number when available.

## Local safety reminder

Use synthetic examples. This intentionally repeats the shared rule for agents starting directly in this workflow.

## Handoff

Put the draft and separate review notes in the user-named output directory. Ask for human review before downstream use.
